title: Maria N FDE 3493 NDE 3493
content: It was on a morning in the month of November. Holding my five-year-old's hand, I crossed one of the streets of the city. I don't know at which moment I crossed from one street to the other without noticing that, as I crossed, towards me came a truck that would take my life. In that moment I saw myself enveloped in an invisible bubble. I floated. I felt as if I'd entered another realm of time. There was a tranquility, a peace, beautiful music in the environment. I felt, at that moment, that I was in a wonderful place, full of peace and love. There was no time - nothing. I felt only that peace, that love, and heard that music. Something protected me. I felt as if I'd always been there. Suddenly, I felt a tug on my hand. My daughter had removed me from the path of the truck that would irremediably have killed me if she hadn't reacted in that manner. At that moment, I left the bubble and returned to reality. My daughter said: 'Mama, that truck was going to trample you.' The people that were present looked at me. I only remained 'lost' in the experience I'd had. How much time had passed? Only a few moments and for me it was a long time in that bubble. I don't know what to think but since that day, I desire that moment and think that death is something beautiful; that something protects you from pain; that there is no suffering.
